envelope.reason: hypothesis 4: a guard fails open, visibly
envelope.cause: rulings on the corrected-shards planner's hypotheses, 2026-09-29

payload.gloss: a guard binds exactly the agents whose composition includes it, on every supported harness, and judges every turn it fires on; where its judge cannot run, it lets the turn through and says so, never silently. Where a harness cannot tell which agent is running, the guard is carried as a stated rule instead and the operator is told; a guard that fires and judges nothing never ships.
